item.title: Eminem Is Auctioning Off Rare Autographed Air Jordans From His Personal Collection for the Marshall Mathers Foundation
item.description:
Here's a short and engaging podcast script based on the article:
[INTRO MUSIC FADES OUT]
Host: "What's up, sneakerheads and Eminem fans? We've got some exciting news for you. The real Slim Shady is auctioning off 117 pairs of sneakers from his personal collection to benefit a great cause. That's right, Eminem has teamed up with Julien's Auctions to raise money for his Marshall Mathers Foundation, which supports disadvantaged and at-risk youth in Detroit."
[CUT TO A SHORT MUSIC TRANSITION]
Host: "So, what's up for grabs? Some seriously rare Air Jordans, including the Air Jordan 3 'Slim Shady' PE that Eminem wore during his Super Bowl LVI Halftime Show performance. Bidding for that pair is already at $8,000 and expected to reach over $25,000. You'll also find Nike Air Max 90s, Adidas, and Pumas, all signed by Eminem himself."
[CUT TO ANOTHER MUSIC TRANSITION]
Host: "The best part? 100% of the proceeds will go towards the Marshall Mathers Foundation. This is the largest single sale of personal merchandise from Eminem's career, and bidding is open now until August 25th. So, if you're looking to cop some exclusive kicks and support a great cause, get ready to bid. We'll keep an eye on the auction and see how much these sneakers end up selling for."
[OUTRO MUSIC FADES IN]
Host: "That's all for now. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you in the next episode!"
